notes.title: Round 14 Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello there!
We hope you all are doing well!

Round 14 is finally complete, and with it, Knockout Master comes to an end. 
We aimed to finish the first game by mid-2025, and we’re happy to say we’ve delivered as promised.
We wanted to make sure everything was ready before sharing the news, so now that the update is done, we’re pleased to finally announce it.

The sequel "Knockout Master 2" is already in the works, and we’re aiming to make many improvements, such as higher-quality renders, smoother animations, and more exciting features we’ll reveal soon.

We'll continue improving the game with regular updates and fixes.
We also have a few other plans for later...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44343899/99b3c2f882179cada221b3f343f9d7e46584a5e0.png[/img]

Round 14 will be released on Steam [b]May 02, 2025.[/b]
This new update includes new content, code fixes, and improvements, along with additional Steam achievements.

Here's the current changelog.

[b]S2 - Round 14 (v1.14 Final):[/b]
[list]
[*] 3200+ New Renders
[*] 280 New Animations 
[*] 2 Animations reworked (R13)
[*] 5 New Phone Wallpapers 
[*] 14 New Gallery Pages
[*] 21 New Steam achievements (WIP)
[*] Phone apps updated
[*] Minor code changes to the Text Messages app
[*] New Music & Sound effects
[*] Minor code fixes & Improvements
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Round 14 Progress Update #5
notes.notes:
Hello there!
We hope you all are doing well!

The next update (Round 14 / v1.14) is now 90% complete.
All the renders and animations are finished. We are now working on coding all the content while the final few scenes' text is being written.

Once that’s complete, we’ll move on to testing the game and fixing all the bugs.
We will share the full changelog and announce the release date as soon as the update is ready.
